scope.purpose: Offer a short list of actions or links in a panel opened from a trigger.
useCases: A grouped action menu with a destructive item.
exclusions: Checkable items and submenus in v1 (open question 3).
alternatives: Select for a value in a form.
ButtonGroup when the actions fit on screen.

decisionsTaken: One compound contract with children item, separator and group (decision of 2026-10-31).

Items use color.item.{default,hover,disabled}; hover is the single highlighted item (pointer or keyboard). intent danger paints the label in color.status.danger.content (contrast pairs on the panel and on the highlighted item: 0 failures).

Items 32 px minimum (size.control.sm), typography.body.sm, padding space.control.padding-inline.sm; item radius.container (8) inside a panel of radius.overlay (12) with space.content.xs padding, so that corners stay concentric.
Keyboard per the WAI-ARIA menu button pattern: arrows wrap, Home and End, typeahead, Enter and Space activate, Escape and Tab close; disabled items are reached but not activated.
Opening by pointer focuses the menu without a highlight; by keyboard highlights the first item.
Inline size: widest item, at least the trigger, at most size.overlay.panel (360 px).
Items accept a leading Icon and a trailing Shortcut (display only).

Open question 3 resolved (user, 2026-11-03: "Ok"): Menu v1 holds actions and links only (item, separator, group); checkable items and submenus come later, on demand, as new children of the same contract.
Open question 2 resolved (user, 2026-11-03: "Ok"): the contract wins over Bits UI DropdownMenu where they disagree, with a local, pinned and tested override.

Bits UI DropdownMenu is not used: its content unmounts when closed (no exit transition) and it manages focus in its own focus scope; decisions.md (2026-10-31) lets ggbrick write its own overlay primitive in that case. The Menu implements the WAI-ARIA menu button pattern on the native auto popover.
Contract fact added during implementation: group leadingSize and leadingGap roles (pending re-presentation).
nextAction: Wave 3 Figma parity gate (grouped): review the master, the specification page and parity.json; then documentation (ggb-docs).
implementationNotes: Exports Menu, MenuItem, MenuSeparator and MenuGroup.

The highlighted item is the focused item (roving focus through focus(), not aria-activedescendant); opening by pointer focuses the menu itself, so no item is highlighted until an arrow key or the pointer.
The trigger opens the menu through popovertarget; ArrowDown and ArrowUp on the trigger open it on the first or last item; Enter or Space mark a keyboard opening.
On opening, the panel is at least as wide as the trigger and never taller than the larger room above or below it.

pendingChanges.change: Contract fact found during implementation: group roles leadingSize (size.icon.sm) and leadingGap (space.control.gap.sm) so that the group heading aligns with item labels when items have a leading icon (the item roles are scoped to items and invisible to the group). To be re-presented at the wave 3 implementation gate.
